title: Engineering: Civil, Mechanical & Electrical in London
raw_title: Engineering: Civil, Mechanical & Electrical in London
subject: Engineering
description_short: Study Engineering at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 16–18—creative projects, expert tutors & an inspiring London setting.
description_full: Study Engineering at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 16–18—creative projects, expert tutors & an inspiring London setting.

curriculum_sections.body: Why Attend an Engineering Summer School? Engineering is curiosity in action and this course combines theory with real world challenges. Explore Mechanics, Civil and Electrical, gaining the tools and mindset to tackle engineering challenges with confidence.London is a global hub for engineering innovation, where cutting-edge research meets real-world application. From advanced technology firms to pioneering infrastructure projects, the city offers unmatched exposure to the industries shaping the future. Your campus, Imperial College London, places you at the centre of this dynamic ecosystem, surrounded by world-leading research, industry partnerships and transformative ideas. Step Into the World Engineering This is more than ordinary classroom learning: dive into the fundamental theory needed to excel in the fields of civil, mechanical and electrical engineering. You'll explore coding, emerging technologies like self-driving cars and space travel and take part in hands-on workshops to build your practical abilities.Gain confidence, master new skills and prepare for a future in engineering.Strengthen Your Problem Solving SkillsDesign Sustainable SolutionsDrone-Coding WorkshopExplore Different Engineering DisciplinesDaily Hands-On ProjectsEngaging Expert TeachersBuild Skills for the Workplace of Tomorrow Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale. Session 1 students will arrive on the Monday. Please see a sample timetable here. View Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideTamoghna DasMScTamoghna Das is a passionate data scientist who holds an MSc in Biochemical Engineering from University College London and a degree in Data Science. He is an educator, designer and engineer and specialises in AI and Biotech. As a researcher and subject matter expert, he shares his skills in execution and client management to help students grasp planning and development of engineering projects. Tamoghna Das MSc Tamoghna Das is a passionate data scientist who holds an MSc in Biochemical Engineering from University College London and a degree in Data Science. He is an educator, designer and engineer and specialises in AI and Biotech. As a researcher and subject matter expert, he shares his skills in execution and client management to help students grasp planning and development of engineering projects. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Individual Projects Take on the role of a final-year engineering apprentice: researching a problem, generating solutions and designing an original product or service to pitch to your organisation. Workshops Hands-on classes designed to help students learn through practical application. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Trusted by parents and students alike Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Hear From Our Students“Here at Oxford Royale, having a diverse mix of classmates helped me build up my argument and debating skills and how to communicate across cultures. Everything I’ve learned here will help me in my future studies, especially when it comes to choosing my research topics. ”YashviOxford Royale AlumHear from Our Parents“The classes were very different from school. We had the hands-on experiences that are really important for learning the subject and it’s helped me decide what I want to do in the future. ”MariaEngineering“I chose to come to Oxford Royale because I wanted an adventure! I also wanted to explore university life and learn more about the subject. I love the lessons here because the teachers make the lessons fun while teaching, lots of practical work.”FemiExplore Engineering“In school, we mostly learn simpler topics, but these classes were different. The lessons went much more in depth and I found them fascinating. If this is what university-level learning is like, I definitely want to go to university. I’ve really enjoyed the experience and I hope university will be just like this.”NicolasExperimental PsychologyPrevious slideNext slide Make connections to last a lifetime The social scene in London is full of possibilities. With Oxford Royale study anatomy, diagnosis and patient care, then practise your skills in simulations designed to feel real. Medicine is more than memorising facts. Learn to think critically, act decisively and care for patients through hands on practice and teamwork.London is a world-leading centre for medicine, research and clinical innovation — the city where penicillin was first discovered. Studying medicine on campus at Imperial College London places you within one of the UK’s most dynamic clinical and research environments, at the forefront of scientific discovery and patient care. Step Into the World of Medicine Study anatomy and physiology, practise examinations and sharpen your diagnostic skills through realistic simulations. Think and act like a doctor while exploring careers from surgeon to researcher. Learn from experienced medics, build confidence and teamwork and spend two weeks in London, discovering world-class museums, culture and life with ambitious peers.Build skills for future medical careerLearn how to diagnose and treatUnderstand human anatomyLearn from case studies and simulationsEngaging Expert Teachers Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideDr Claire KeeneMSc, PhDDr Claire Keene is a public health clinician with a masters in International Health and Tropical Medicine from the University of Oxford. She is an experienced clinical trial manager, formerly managing a Médecins Sans Frontières project on HIV and tuberculosis. Dr Claire Keene MSc, PhD Dr Claire Keene is a public health clinician with a masters in International Health and Tropical Medicine from the University of Oxford. She is an experienced clinical trial manager, formerly managing a Médecins Sans Frontières project on HIV and tuberculosis. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Group Projects Take on a real clinical skills assessment; taking a patient's history, outlining an examination and presenting a diagnosis and management plan under exam conditions. Workshops Try advanced medical diagnostic equipment from ultrasound and ECGs to suturing, blood-taking and keyhole surgery in a hands-on clinical skills workshop. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Trusted by parents and students alike From the first day to the last, our students discover the best version of themselves. Read their stories and see why Oxford Royale leaves a mark that lasts a lifetime. Hear From Our Students“Here at Oxford Royale, having a diverse mix of classmates helped me build up my argument and debating skills and how to communicate across cultures. Everything I’ve learned here will help me in my future studies, especially when it comes to choosing my research topics. ”YashviOxford Royale AlumHear from Our Parents“The classes were very different from school. We had the hands-on experiences that are really important for learning the subject and it’s helped me decide what I want to do in the future. ”MariaEngineering“I chose to come to Oxford Royale because I wanted an adventure! I also wanted to explore university life and learn more about the subject. I love the lessons here because the teachers make the lessons fun while teaching, lots of practical work.”FemiExplore Engineering“In school, we mostly learn simpler topics, but these classes were different. The lessons went much more in depth and I found them fascinating. If this is what university-level learning is like, I definitely want to go to university. I’ve really enjoyed the experience and I hope university will be just like this.”NicolasExperimental PsychologyPrevious slideNext slide Make connections to last a lifetime The social scene in London is full of possibilities. Students can expect creative workshops, group outings, relaxed welcome events and evenings exploring local culture - all set against the buzz of one of the world’s most exciting cities.Creative workshops that spark collaboration and fresh ideasGroup outings to museums, galleries and riverside destinationsWelcome activities that help everyone connect from day oneDebate society and grand finalFun social opportunities woven into city life

title: Architecture & Design in Oxford
subject: Architecture
description_short: Study Architecture & Design at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 16–18—creative projects, expert tutors & an inspiring Oxford setting.
description_full: Study Architecture & Design at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 16–18—creative projects, expert tutors & an inspiring Oxford setting.

curriculum_sections.body: Why Attend an Architecture Summer School? Architecture is creativity in action, where history, design and innovation meet. Learn architecture from concept to construction through creative challenges, model-making and technical drawing, building the skills to bring your ideas to life. Step Into the World of Architecture Step into the world of architecture, exploring how ideas become structures through creative challenges, model-making and technical drawing. Discover design across history, learn to map sites and build models and experiment with colour and form. With hands-on practice and inspiring surroundings, you’ll develop the skills to bring bold architectural concepts to life.Bring architecture to life in one of the UK's most architecturally outstanding cities.Oxford Architecture ToursSite Visits and MappingEngaging Expert TeachersEmerging Design TechnologiesModel BuildingUrban Planning ChallengeSustainable City Project Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideLana Al-ShamiMALana graduated with a Master of Arts with distinction before qualifying as an Architect in 2007. She has lectured in Architecture and Interior Architecture and Design at university in London. She has a keen interest in sustainable development and conservation and has worked on many award winning buildings throughout her career. Lana is also an artist and designer and has exhibited her work around the UK as well as internationally. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Group Projects Design a house and studio for a violin maker, producing sketches, technical drawings, physical and digital models and a full design proposal, culminating in a final crit presentation to the class. Workshops Explore colour psychology, follow the timeline of an interior design project and create an inspiration board in response to a client brief (Session 1 & 3). Work on a real client brief to create, design and present your own interior concept using professional tools and techniques (Session 2). How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Make connections to last a lifetime Our social programme is all about connection, creativity and giving students space to try new things. From punting and hands-on workshops to debate evenings, gallery visits and relaxed welcome events, there’s always something inspiring happening after classes.Punting on the Cherwell with friendsCreative workshops designed to spark imagination and confidenceDebate society evenings for big ideas and bold voicesKaraoke, talent shows and fashion workshopsVisits to museums, galleries, the Covered Market and WestgateFriendly welcome activities to help everyone settle in quickly

Then tackle social issues like fake news and explore psychology’s power to solve real-world challenges. Step Into the World Psychology Explore how psychology explains our experience of the world by investigating behaviour, personality and memory through hands-on research. Design your own study, analyse real data and apply psychological insights to modern challenges. Gain expert-led learning, collaborative skills and the confidence needed to thrive in advanced psychology and beyond.Group Research & PresentationsDaily Hands-On ProjectsEngaging Expert TeachersDesign your own experimentsExplore Different Career PathsUnderstand Psychology in PracticePractical Workshops and Simulations From unforgettable moments to lasting inspirations - discover the Oxford Royale Experience Our Summer School brings together students from around the world to study in the heart of Oxford. In this highlights film, you'll hear first hand how the blend of inspiring lessons, historic venues and new friendships create a truly life-changing experience. Enrol Now Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. detail_sections.body: Why Attend a Business Summer School? Oxford Royale's business programme gives curious students a head start in one of today’s most dynamic fields. Through foundational theory and practical case studies, you’ll explore core principles and real-world applications, building skills that shape tomorrow’s leaders. title: Explore Engineering
subject: Engineering
description_short: Experience engineering at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 12–15—hands-on projects, expert teaching & new global friends.
description_full: Experience engineering at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 12–15—hands-on projects, expert teaching & new global friends.

curriculum_sections.body: Why Attend an Engineering Summer School? Engineering is curiosity in action and this course from Oxford Royale combines theory with real world challenges. Explore Mechanics, Civil and Electrical, gaining the tools and mindset to tackle engineering challenges with confidence. Learn the principals, then work on practical builds, test your designs and solve real-life problems alongside like-minded peers. Step Into the World of Engineering Be the engineer of your future by exploring civil, mechanical and electrical engineering while diving into emerging technologies. Build skills through hands-on robotics, learn from expert academics, discover your pathway and experience life in historic Oxford colleges alongside ambitious, like-minded students.Explore mechanical, electrical and civil engineeringBuild your own Mars RoverDesign a sustainable city of the futureDaily Hands-On ProjectsEngaging Expert TeachersGroup Research & Presentations Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideDr Ameer JabaniResearcherDr Ameer Janabi is a researcher at the University of Cambridge and an entrepreneur in electric mobility and power electronics. He founded Hardcore Power Electronics in the United States, now partnered with FEV North America and Cambridge Integration in the United Kingdom, which is developing integrated approaches to power electronics. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Group Projects Research and present a solution to a real sustainability challenge; from clean water shortages to carbon emissions, using engineering thinking to make the case for change. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Workshops Build robots and code them for battle at our Programme & Build Workshop; combining science, engineering, technology and maths in one hands-on STEM experience. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Trusted by parents and students alike Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Hear From Our Students“I have never been to Oxford before and now I love it. The buildings and the history are incredible. My favourite part has been the people. I have met so many people from all over the world and I have made some lifelong friends. ”LauraBusiness, Innovation & EntrepreneurshipHear from Our Parents“The classes were very different from school. We had the hands-on experiences that are really important for learning the subject and it’s helped me decide what I want to do in the future. ”MariaEngineering“I chose to come to Oxford Royale because I wanted an adventure! I also wanted to explore university life and learn more about the subject. I love the lessons here because the teachers make the lessons fun while teaching, lots of practical work.”FemiExplore Engineering“In school, we mostly learn simpler topics, but these classes were different. The lessons went much more in depth and I found them fascinating. If this is what university-level learning is like, I definitely want to go to university. I’ve really enjoyed the experience and I hope university will be just like this.”NicolasExperimental PsychologyPrevious slideNext slide Make connections to last a lifetime Our social programme is all about connection, creativity and giving students space to try new things. From punting and hands-on workshops to debate evenings, gallery visits and relaxed welcome events, there’s always something inspiring happening after classes.Punting on the Cherwell with friendsCreative workshops designed to spark imagination and confidenceDebate society evenings for big ideas and bold voicesKaraoke, talent shows and fashion workshopsVisits to museums, galleries, the Covered Market and WestgateFriendly welcome activities to help everyone settle in quickly

curriculum_sections.body: Why Attend a Law Summer School? Learn how the UK legal system works and why it matters. Build the skills to analyse, argue and apply the law. Bring the fundamentals of law to life through investigations, mock trials and debates that build your confidence to think like a lawyer and communicate with clarity and precision. Step Into the world of Law Take your first step into the world of law as you explore key legal fields, investigate real cases and build practical skills through a dynamic mock trial. Group Projects Work as a legal team to prepare and deliver a full mock trial, taking on roles as barristers, witnesses and jurors to explore a fictional murder case from evidence to verdict. title: Explore Medicine in Oxford
subject: Medicine
description_short: Experience medicine at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 12–15—hands-on projects, expert teaching & new global friends.
description_full: Experience medicine at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 12–15—hands-on projects, expert teaching & new global friends.

curriculum_sections.body: Why Attend a Medicine Summer School? Want to step into medicine? With Oxford Royale study anatomy, diagnosis and patient care, then practice your skills in simulations designed to feel like the real thing. Medicine is more than memorising facts. Learn how to think critically, act decisively and care for patients through hands-on practice and teamwork. Step Into the World of Medicine Study anatomy, physiology and disease while exploring real medical cases and how doctors diagnose and treat patients. Build clinical thinking through hands-on simulations, discover future medical pathways and learn from expert medics. Develop key teamwork and communication skills while experiencing life in historic Oxford colleges alongside ambitious, like-minded students.Understand human anatomyLearn how to diagnose and treatClinical skills practical workshopEngaging Expert TeachersGroup Research & Presentations Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideDr Claire KeeneMSC, PhDDr Claire Keene is a public health clinician with a masters in International Health and Tropical Medicine from the University of Oxford. She is an experienced clinical trial manager, formerly managing a Médecins Sans Frontières project on HIV and tuberculosis. Dr Claire Keene MSC, PhD Dr Claire Keene is a public health clinician with a masters in International Health and Tropical Medicine from the University of Oxford. She is an experienced clinical trial manager, formerly managing a Médecins Sans Frontières project on HIV and tuberculosis. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Projects Participate in a clinical scenario exam where they will take a history using the history taking proforma and present a differential diagnosis and management plan. Workshops Visit a real clinical skills simulation centre and try your hand at CPR, wound dressing, taking observations and using a high-tech Simman in a simulated hospital ward. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Trusted by parents and students alike Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Hear From Our Students“I have never been to Oxford before and now I love it. The buildings and the history are incredible. My favourite part has been the people. I have met so many people from all over the world and I have made some lifelong friends. ”LauraBusiness, Innovation & EntrepreneurshipHear from Our Parents“The classes were very different from school. We had the hands-on experiences that are really important for learning the subject and it’s helped me decide what I want to do in the future. ”MariaEngineering“I chose to come to Oxford Royale because I wanted an adventure! Film is more than watching stories unfold. Learn how to craft them yourself, gaining hands-on experience in production, directing and digital editing as you bring your vision to life. Step Into the World of Film Master professional filmmaking by learning to use HD cameras, sound and lighting to bring your vision to life. Develop expert editing skills with Final Cut Pro and take your film through post-production. Then work in teams to create a full production package and pitch your story to a live audience for GreenLight approval.Group Research & PresentationsDaily Hands-On ProjectsEngaging Expert TeachersLearn on professional camera and equipmentPractise digital editing skills using Final Cut ProWork with film industry expertsDirect, shoot and edit a film from scratch From unforgettable moments to lasting inspirations - discover the Oxford Royale Experience Our Summer School brings together students from around the world to study in the heart of Oxford. In this highlights film, you'll hear first hand how the blend of inspiring lessons, historic venues and new friendships create a truly life-changing experience. Enrol Now Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideBruce WindwoodFilmmaker Windwood is a multi-award winning filmmaker with credits including the comedy feature film 12 In A Box. Bruce is a commissioned writer for TV and audio as well as a composer for film, audio and TV soundtracks. Having helped to design, develop and expand ORA’s filmmaking classes over the last 11 years, Bruce is one of the most senior tutors. He also regularly teaches short and long-form filmmaking at the prestigious National Film & TV School as well as Film Oxford. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Guest Speakers Hear from leading minds about the changes shaping the future Seminars Learn from experts in an engaging environment Trusted by parents and students alike Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Hear From Our Students“I have never been to Oxford before and now I love it. The buildings and the history are incredible. My favourite part has been the people. I have met so many people from all over the world and I have made some lifelong friends. ”LauraBusiness, Innovation & EntrepreneurshipHear from Our Parents“The classes were very different from school. We had the hands-on experiences that are really important for learning the subject and it’s helped me decide what I want to do in the future. ”MariaEngineering“I chose to come to Oxford Royale because I wanted an adventure! I also wanted to explore university life and learn more about the subject. I love the lessons here because the teachers make the lessons fun while teaching, lots of practical work.”FemiExplore Engineering“In school, we mostly learn simpler topics, but these classes were different. The lessons went much more in depth and I found them fascinating. If this is what university-level learning is like, I definitely want to go to university. I’ve really enjoyed the experience and I hope university will be just like this.”NicolasExperimental PsychologyPrevious slideNext slide An unforgettable summer Exploring Oxford should feel like stepping into a story you get to live in. title: History, Philosophy & Literature in Oxford
subject: History
description_short: Study History, Philosophy & Literature at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 16–18—creative projects, expert tutors & an inspiring Oxford setting.
description_full: Study History, Philosophy & Literature at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 16–18—creative projects, expert tutors & an inspiring Oxford setting.

curriculum_sections.body: Why Attend a History, Philosophy & Literature Summer School? From ancient philosophy to modern literature, explore the big ideas and timeless works that influence how we live today. Discuss and debate the big ideas, sharpening your skills through debates and assignments to write with impact and speak with confidence. Step Into the World of History, Philosophy & Literature Hone critical thinking and persuasive argumentation to express and defend ideas with clarity and confidence. Explore Oxford’s publishing legacy at the OUP Museum and uncover five centuries of influence, then dive into the Ashmolean’s collections to discover art across cultures and eras: connecting ideas, history and creative practice.Group Research & PresentationsDaily Hands-On ProjectsEngaging Expert TeachersBuild Skills for Dynamic CareersAcademic Showcase projectAshmolean Museum TourExplore History’s Defining Moments Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideDr Claire KeeneMSC, PhDDr Claire Keene is a public health clinician with a masters in International Health and Tropical Medicine from the University of Oxford. She is an experienced clinical trial manager, formerly managing a Médecins Sans Frontières project on HIV and tuberculosis. Dr Claire Keene MSC, PhD Dr Claire Keene is a public health clinician with a masters in International Health and Tropical Medicine from the University of Oxford. She is an experienced clinical trial manager, formerly managing a Médecins Sans Frontières project on HIV and tuberculosis. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Individual Projects Research and deliver a 10–15 minute presentation on a topic of your choosing; from the fall of the Soviet Union to the role of dystopian fiction, arguing your case to an audience of peers. Workshops Explore centuries of literary heritage at Oxford University Press's archives (Oxford, Sessions 2 & 3), or analyse artworks across cultures and time at the Ashmolean Museum with expert guides. (Oxford, Session 1) How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Academic Trips Explore your subject first-hand through visits to Oxford's fascinating museums and libraries Make connections to last a lifetime Our social programme is all about connection, creativity and giving students space to try new things. From punting and hands-on workshops to debate evenings, gallery visits and relaxed welcome events, there’s always something inspiring happening after classes.Punting on the Cherwell with friendsCreative workshops designed to spark imagination and confidenceDebate society evenings for big ideas and bold voicesKaraoke, talent shows and fashion workshopsVisits to museums, galleries, the Covered Market and WestgateFriendly welcome activities to help everyone settle in quickly

curriculum_sections.body: Why Attend a Marketing Summer School? Marketing changes fast. Learn how to stay ahead. From consumer behaviour to AI-driven campaigns, you’ll explore the skills and tools that make you more than just market-ready. Push beyond theory into real-world marketing, creating campaigns that work and measure the results that matter. Step Into the World of Marketing Build marketing skills through real case studies as you learn to evaluate campaigns, turn consumer insights into impactful strategies and create attention-grabbing short-form videos. From trend analysis to content production, develop the tools to stand out and thrive in a fast-changing consumer landscape, preparing for success in modern marketing.Group Research & PresentationsDaily Hands-On ProjectsEngaging Expert TeachersBuild skills for Marketing CareersDelve into Influencer MarketingUnderstand How Brands WorkLearn from Case Studies and Simulations Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideDr Anisa ButtLecturer at King's College LondonA member of the Oxford Royale team for many years, Anisa Butt is a lecturer in economics at King’s College London. Workshops Learn to create scroll-stopping short-form video content for Reels and TikTok, analysing trends, developing content strategies and filming and editing your own videos. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Trusted by parents and students alike Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. description_short: Study Sustainability and the Environment at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 16–18—creative projects, expert tutors & an inspiring Oxford setting.
description_full: Study Sustainability and the Environment at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 16–18—creative projects, expert tutors & an inspiring Oxford setting.

curriculum_sections.body: Why Attend a Sustainability & the Environment Summer School? Turn your commitment to the planet into real impact. Explore climate change, environmental policy, conservation and global leadership - all while solving real sustainability challenges through debates, case studies and collaborative projects with passionate peers from around the world. Step into the World of Sustainability Turn your passion for the planet into action by studying climate change, policy and leadership while tackling real challenges through case studies, debates and projects. Build climate-conscious leadership skills, explore conservation methods and step into global diplomacy through a UN Mock Summit. Gain practical and academic tools for future high-impact careers.Group Research & Environmental PresentationsDaily Hands-On Sustainability ProjectsLearn From Climate & Conservation SpecialistsBuild Skills for Tomorrow’s Green EconomyLearn How Sustainable Businesses OperateExplore Careers in High-Impact Environmental SectorsMove Toward Global Environmental Leadership Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideBlanka HoligovaInternational Relations & DiplomacyDedicated lecturer in Politics with over 15 years of teaching experience across diverse educational settings. With a postgraduate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy, Blanka has a strong foundation in global politics, international affairs and diplomatic studies, which she integrates into her teaching to provide students with both theoretical understanding and real-world context. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Group Projects Develop your own Sustainability Accord, researching a real climate issue, proposing evidence-based solutions and presenting your findings as a delegate at a sustainability summit. Workshops Take on the role of a green professional, ecologist, engineer, sustainability consultant, or eco-artist, to collaboratively tackle a real-world environmental issue. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. subject: Engineering
description_short: Study Engineering at Oxford Royale’s summer school in Yale for ages 16–18—creative projects, supportive tutors & an inspiring university setting.
description_full: Study Engineering at Oxford Royale’s summer school in Yale for ages 16–18—creative projects, supportive tutors & an inspiring university setting.

curriculum_sections.body: Why attend an Engineering Summer School? Engineering is curiosity in action and this course combines theory with real world challenges. Explore Mechanics, Civil and Electrical, gaining the tools and mindset to tackle engineering challenges with confidence. Learn the principals, then work on practical builds, test your designs and solve real-life problems alongside like-minded peers.Studying engineering on campus with Oxford Royale at Yale University places you within a dynamic environment driven by innovation and discovery. With a strong tradition of scientific research and technological advancement, Yale offers an inspiring setting to explore how engineering shapes the modern world.Immersed in this forward-thinking academic community, you examine real-world challenges, develop problem-solving skills and experience campus life at an institution renowned for intellectual excellence and global impact. Step Into the World of Engineering This is more than ordinary classroom learning: dive into the fundamental theory needed to excel in the fields of civil, mechanical and electrical engineering. You'll explore coding, emerging technologies like self-driving cars and space travel and take part in hands-on workshops to build your practical abilities.Strengthen Your Problem Solving SkillsDaily Hands-On ProjectsEngaging Expert TeachersExplore Different Engineering DisciplinesDesign Sustainable SolutionsBuild Skills for the Workplace of Tomorrow Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideDr Ameer JabaniResearcherDr Ameer Janabi is a researcher at the University of Cambridge and an entrepreneur in electric mobility and power electronics. He founded Hardcore Power Electronics in the United States, now partnered with FEV North America and Cambridge Integration in the United Kingdom, which is developing integrated approaches to power electronics. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Individual Projects Take on the role of a final-year engineering apprentice: researching a problem, generating solutions and designing an original product or service to pitch to your organisation. Workshops Hands-on classes designed to help students learn through practical application. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Yale: Experience the Ivy League Tradition Explore the historic campus and vibrant cultural scene of New Haven, a city known for its arts, architecture and academic heritage. With striking Gothic buildings, renowned museums and a close-knit student atmosphere, Yale offers a distinctive Ivy League experience. Visit Yale Faculties Experience the buzz of academic life and explore Yale University’s renowned faculties, stepping into the spaces where groundbreaking ideas continue to be developed and a legacy of leadership has shaped global history for over three centuries! You will have the opportunity to see areas such as the Yale School of Management, the Yale Law Library and the Center for Engineering Innovation and Design (CEID). Friday Night Party Nothing captures the quintessential "American College Experience" like a high-energy Friday night social, where the campus transforms into a vibrant hub of music, dancing and school spirit. This exclusive event provides the perfect atmosphere for students to unwind after a week of elite academics, fostering lifelong international friendships and unforgettable memories in the heart of a storied Ivy League setting. Graduation Celebrate the end of your course in style at your Oxford Royale graduation. Have the chance to dress in your best clothes and receive a certificate that showcases all your hard work during the course, joined with the new friends you’ve made. Trusted by parents and students alike Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Hear From Our Students“The classes were very different from school. We had the hands-on experiences that are really important for learning the subject and it’s helped me decide what I want to do in the future. ”MariaEngineeringHear from Our Parents“I chose to come to Oxford Royale because I wanted an adventure! I also wanted to explore university life and learn more about the subject. I love the lessons here because the teachers make the lessons fun while teaching, lots of practical work.”FemiExplore Engineering“In school, we mostly learn simpler topics, but these classes were different. The lessons went much more in depth and I found them fascinating. If this is what university-level learning is like, I definitely want to go to university. I’ve really enjoyed the experience and I hope university will be just like this.”NicolasExperimental PsychologyPrevious slideNext slide Make connections to last a lifetime Our social timetable is all about allowing students to make new friends and explore new ventures, surrounded by their historic setting. curriculum_sections.body: Experience the Ivy League like never before This summer, join a select group of scholars following in the footsteps of presidents, pioneers and Nobel Laureates, as you study and immerse yourself in academic life at three of the world’s most renowned Ivy League universities.Step into campus life amid Yale’s historic ivy-covered courtyards and Columbia’s dynamic city energy. Plus the opportunity to explore Cambridge, Massachusetts, the historic university town which is home to Harvard University. Study Leadership Where Leaders Are Made Begin with private leadership seminars at Yale in politics, philosophy and economics. Explore the historic academic centre of Harvard, then turn insight into impact at Columbia through practical workshops and curated visits to the United Nations and New York landmarks. Far more than a taste of Ivy League life, this crafted programme gives a true understanding of what it means to study in these iconic institutions and inspires a vision for your own future path.Lectures, workshops & case studies in Global LeadershipYale faculty visits and fascinating talks from faculty staffSharpen critical thinking skills with debate workshopsGuided tours of Harvard, Columbia and Yale Curated visits to the United Nations, the Met and Natural History MuseumImmerse yourself in New York visiting landmarks and a cruise on the Hudson RiverEnjoy Wicked on Broadway plus private workshop with producer discussing financing a multi-million-dollar production Download the brochure Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. curriculum_sections.body: Experience the Ivy League like never before This summer, join a select group of scholars following in the footsteps of presidents, pioneers and Nobel Laureates, as you study and immerse yourself in academic life at three of the world’s most renowned Ivy League universities.Step into campus life amid Yale’s historic ivy-covered courtyards and Columbia’s dynamic city energy. Plus the opportunity to explore Cambridge, Massachusetts, the historic university town which is home to Harvard University. Study Leadership Where Leaders Are Made Begin with private leadership seminars at Yale in politics, philosophy and economics. Explore the historic academic centre of Harvard, then turn insight into impact at Columbia through practical workshops and curated visits to the United Nations and New York landmarks. Far more than a taste of Ivy League life, this crafted programme gives a true understanding of what it means to study in these iconic institutions and inspires a vision for your own future path.Lectures, workshops & case studies in Global LeadershipYale faculty visits and fascinating talks from faculty staffSharpen critical thinking skills with debate workshopsGuided tours of Harvard, Columbia and Yale Curated visits to the United Nations, the Met and Natural History MuseumImmerse yourself in New York visiting landmarks and a cruise on the Hudson RiverEnjoy Wicked on Broadway plus private workshop with producer discussing financing a multi-million-dollar production From unforgettable moments to lasting inspirations - discover the Oxford Royale Experience Our Summer School brings students together from around the world to study on campus at Yale and Barnard College, Columbia. In this highlights film, you'll hear first-hand how the blend of inspiring lessons, historic venues and new friendships create a truly life-changing experience. Enrol Now Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideTamy-Feé MeneideIvy League Admissions SpeakerTamy-Feé is an educational consultant, mentorship strategist and experienced academic speaker with a decade of guiding students through their higher education journeys. Drawing on her extensive background in university settings, including past admissions experience at MIT and Dartmouth and degrees from Boston College, she specializes in helping students discover their authentic academic voice and articulate their unique educational narratives. She is dedicated to helping young scholars translate their personal and academic experiences into compelling, confident reflections that stand out, ensuring they are fully prepared to take their next steps toward higher education with clarity and purpose. Tamy-Feé Meneide Ivy League Admissions Speaker Tamy-Feé is an educational consultant, mentorship strategist and experienced academic speaker with a decade of guiding students through their higher education journeys. Drawing on her extensive background in university settings, including past admissions experience at MIT and Dartmouth and degrees from Boston College, she specializes in helping students discover their authentic academic voice and articulate their unique educational narratives. She is dedicated to helping young scholars translate their personal and academic experiences into compelling, confident reflections that stand out, ensuring they are fully prepared to take their next steps toward higher education with clarity and purpose. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Seminars Learn from experts in an engaging environment. Guest Speakers Hear from leading minds about the changes shaping the future. Three Ivy League Campuses. Two Unforgettable weeks. At Yale, past and future converge. In New York, you’re at the heart of culture and leadership. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to get a hands-on insight into Ivy League life. Wicked the Musical - with Behind the Scenes Workshop In the morning, students attend an exclusive Broadway Bound Workshop with a professional producer to deconstruct the high-stakes financing and management of a multi-million-dollar production. The day culminates in the evening with a performance of the global phenomenon Wicked, allowing the cohort to witness the spectacular result of that strategic leadership in action. Exclusive Guest Speakers Virtual Admissions Workshop: Tamy-Feé MeneideWith admissions experience from both MIT and Dartmouth, Tamy-Feé is an educational consultant and admissions strategist with a background in higher education and over a decade of experience guiding students through highly selective admissions processes.Live Admissions Workshop: Dr. Sergey R, Ivy League Admissions ExpertDr. Sergey R has helped students gain admission to Stanford, Princeton, Brown, Cornell, NYU, UC Berkeley, UChicago and more.Psychology-Focused Session: Monroe EgbuchunamMonroe Egbuchunam is social media UX researcher in cognitive psychology, HCI and algorithmic bias studying marginalized users’ experiences with digital platforms and AI. Night in K-Town For a true taste of New York City’s vibrant energy, students head to K-Town (Koreatown) for an evening of high-energy fun and cultural immersion. Nestled in the heart of Midtown, this neon-lit district serves as the perfect backdrop for a quintessential NYC experience. The night culminates in a private karaoke session, where students can let loose, bond with their peers and build lasting memories. Visit to Wall Street A professional visit to Wall Street places students at the epicenter of global capitalism and economic leadership. Walking through the Financial District, the cohort will analyze the historical and modern-day impact of the New York Stock Exchange and the Federal Reserve, observing how high-stakes decision-making here ripples across international markets. The Met A visit to The Metropolitan Museum of Art offers an unparalleled look at 5,000 years of global history through the lens of creative and strategic leadership. As students explore world-class masterpieces—from the ancient Temple of Dendur to the Renaissance galleries—they witness how art has been used as a tool for political influence, cultural identity and social change Manuscript Library Experience history at the Beinecke Rare Book & Manuscript Library, the literary archive of Yale University. One of the largest buildings dedicated to rare books, the library contains more than a million books — a book-lover’s dream! Graduation Celebrate the end of your course in style at your Oxford Royale graduation. Have the chance to dress in your best clothes and receive a certificate that showcases all your hard work during the course, joined with the new friends you’ve made. Trusted by parents and students alike From the first day to the last, our students discover the best version of themselves. Read their stories and see why Oxford Royale leaves a mark that lasts a lifetime. Hear from our students“In school, we mostly learn simpler topics, but these classes were different. The lessons went much more in depth and I found them fascinating. If this is what university-level learning is like, I definitely want to go to university. I've really enjoyed this experience and I hope university will be just like this.”NicolasExperimental PsychologyHear from our parents“I have never been to Oxford before and now I love it. The buildings and the history are incredible. My favourite part has been the people. I have met so many people from all over the world and I have made some lifelong friends.”LauraBusiness“I wanted to explore university life and learn more about my subject. I loved the lessons here because the teachers make the lessons engaging and we take part in practical work all linked to the course. ”FemiEngineeringPrevious slideNext slide Immerse yourself in three unforgettable locations Experience the best of the East Coast in one unforgettable journey.Go behind the scenes at Yale with insider tours, the Peabody Museum and the School of Management and discover what makes New Haven unique.Dive into New York’s energy with a guided Met visit, Central Park tours, K-Town nights and an exclusive Wicked performance with a behind-the-scenes workshop.Then head to Cambridge, Massachusetts for a must-see Harvard experience: student-led campus tour, student panel insights and a guest lecture. Make lasting connections Social life is lively, creative and full

title: Law & Trial Advocacy Academy
subject: Law
description_short: Study Law & Trial Advocacy at Oxford Royale’s summer school in Yale for ages 16–18—creative projects, supportive tutors & an inspiring university setting.
description_full: Study Law & Trial Advocacy at Oxford Royale’s summer school in Yale for ages 16–18—creative projects, supportive tutors & an inspiring university setting.

curriculum_sections.body: Why attend a Law Summer School? Step into the shoes of a lawyer and experience the exciting world of law, justice and advocacy. This course offers a unique combination of academic exploration and courtroom simulation, giving you a head start in understanding legal systems and sharpening your skills in argumentation and critical thinking.Studying law on campus with Oxford Royale at Yale University places you within one of the most influential legal and academic environments in the world. Renowned for its intellectual rigour and tradition of public service, Yale fosters critical thinking, debate and a deep understanding of how law shapes society.Immersed in this inspiring setting, you explore key legal principles while experiencing campus life at an institution long associated with leadership, global impact and excellence in legal scholarship. Step Into the World of Law Explore the world of law through hands-on advocacy. Build foundations in constitutional, criminal and human rights law, analyse real cases and practice crafting arguments, questioning witnesses and presenting confidently in simulated trials and debates.Foundations Of Key Legal FieldsDaily Hands-On ProjectsEngaging Expert TeachersTwo Mock TrialsReal Case Study AnalysisPublic Speaking and Debate SkillsVisit the Yale Law Library, with specialist PhD guide Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideYusuf OlalereMScYusuf is an Associate in the Corporate Practice, working from London while supporting the New York team. He holds an MSc in Law & Finance from the University of Oxford, giving him a strong interdisciplinary grounding in both legal and financial aspects of complex corporate transactions. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Group Projects Act as a team of junior attorneys preparing a case briefing on a major area of U.S. law; researching landmark cases, explaining legal principles clearly and presenting to an audience of peers and stakeholders. Workshops Hands-on classes designed to help students learn through practical application. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Yale: Experience the Ivy League Tradition Explore the historic campus and vibrant cultural scene of New Haven, a city known for its arts, architecture and academic heritage. With striking Gothic buildings, renowned museums and a close-knit student atmosphere, Yale offers a distinctive Ivy League experience. Visit Yale Faculties Experience the buzz of academic life and explore Yale University’s renowned faculties, stepping into the spaces where groundbreaking ideas continue to be developed and a legacy of leadership has shaped global history for over three centuries! You will have the opportunity to see areas such as the Yale School of Management, the Yale Law Library and the Center for Engineering Innovation and Design (CEID). Friday Night Party Nothing captures the quintessential "American College Experience" like a high-energy Friday night social, where the campus transforms into a vibrant hub of music, dancing and school spirit. This exclusive event provides the perfect atmosphere for students to unwind after a week of elite academics, fostering lifelong international friendships and unforgettable memories in the heart of a storied Ivy League setting. Graduation Celebrate the end of your course in style at your Oxford Royale graduation. Have the chance to dress in your best clothes and receive a certificate that showcases all your hard work during the course, joined with the new friends you’ve made. Make connections to last a lifetime Our social timetable is all about allowing students to make new friends and explore new ventures, surrounded by their historic setting. Students can expect creative workshops, group outings, relaxed welcome events and trips exploring local culture in this atmospheric college town.Creative workshops that spark collaboration and fresh ideasGroup outings to museums, galleries and Yale facultyWelcome activities that help everyone connect from day oneJournalism club, Debate society and grand final

title: Active English
subject: Active English
description_short: Grow in confidence in all four English language skills (speaking, listening, reading, writing) and learn outside the classroom with visits to places of cultural and historical interest in Oxford and beyond.
description_full: Grow in confidence in all four English language skills (speaking, listening, reading, writing) and learn outside the classroom with visits to places of cultural and historical interest in Oxford and beyond.

curriculum_sections.title: Course benefits
curriculum_sections.body: 1. Supportive environment with a high staff-to-student ratio Benefit from a supportive classroom environment and strong pastoral care. Our caring staff help you thrive during your time here and our friendly team of residential activity leaders lead an action-packed programme and accompany you on excursions.. 2. Specialist English language teaching Develop your English language skills with our professional and qualified English teachers and learn with your peers in split classes between those aged 9-12 and 13-15. 3. Interactive learning Language teaching focuses on topical Weekly Themes. The weekly excursions are a mix of historical, cultural and fun activities which students are introduced to in the classroom before their visit. 4. Gain a rich cultural experience Visit cultural and historical locations in Oxford and places nearby like London, Bath and Windsor Castle. 5. International atmosphere We cultivate an international atmosphere, welcoming students from around the world who enjoy living and learning together. 6. Enjoyable study visits, activities and excursions Discover Oxford and the UK, with up to 3 excursions per week. Our programme also includes activities such as arts and crafts, quizzes, sports, a disco, talent shows and much more. 7. Attractive and safe campus Our study environment is a secure residential campus with a range of facilities and beautiful open spaces. 8. Learn in a global city Oxford is a world-famous academic city. It is a multicultural city with a rich heritage and has lots to see and do. LEO CHINA, ACTIVE ENGLISH 2023 " I would definitely recommend St Clare’s because the environment here is very good and the teachers are friendly and kind. The lessons are really fun, it doesn’t feel like school, it’s just like another family! ” Course Structure Grow in confidence in all four English language skills (speaking, listening, reading, writing) and learn outside the classroom with visits to places of cultural and historical interest in Oxford and beyond. Afternoon Electives Choose 1 option per week: Football Coaching Improve your football skills with our professional Football Association qualified coaches Tennis Coaching Enhance your tennis skills with coaching from professional LTA qualified coaches Performing Arts Enjoy workshops with qualified and experienced coaches to develop skills in a range of performing arts including acting, dance, public speaking and improvisation. Performing Arts Discover the world of performance through our engaging Performing Arts elective, delivered by Abie Walton from The North Wall Theatre in Summertown as part of our exciting partnership with the theatre. Open to all students on the Junior programme, this six-hour-per-week elective requires no previous experience or language ability - just enthusiasm and a willingness to get involved. Through a varied programme of improvisation, character exploration and devising physical theatre, students can join for one week or several, developing valuable skills in teamwork, voice and articulation, personal presentation, public speaking and thinking on their feet. Our partnership with The North Wall also provides unique opportunities beyond the classroom, including hosting participants from their ArtsLab programme, gallery visits and artist talks and the use of the theatre by our IB students for their end-of-year performance.

title: Active English + STEM
subject: Active English + STEM
description_short: Build in all four English language skills while exploring the exciting world of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Maths).
description_full: Build in all four English language skills while exploring the exciting world of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Maths).

curriculum_sections.title: Course benefits
curriculum_sections.body: Combine English with STEM Build all four English language skills while exploring the exciting world of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Maths) and learn with your peers in split classes between those aged 9-12 and 13-15. Hands-On Learning Take part in practical challenges and workshops that will help you build your skills in STEM. From coding and construction to fun and engaging science and maths sessions at our IB World School, you’ll have many chances to learn new ideas and put them into practice. Learn from Specialists Benefit from STEM teaching, with expert staff guiding you through interactive and project-based learning. Explore Oxford’s Academic Heritage Study in one of the world’s most famous academic cities, home to the University of Oxford, with visits that connect classroom learning to real-world innovation. Boost Confidence in English STEM projects are taught through English, helping you develop subject vocabulary and strengthen communication skills in authentic contexts. Work in Teams Collaborate with classmates from around the world on exciting group projects – just like real scientists and engineers. Future-Focused Experience Gain early exposure to STEM subjects in an international setting, preparing you for future studies and inspiring a passion for discovery. All the Benefits of Junior Programmes Enjoy the same safe campus, supportive staff, comfortable accommodation, international community and action-packed activities and excursions programme as our other junior courses. LEO CHINA, ACTIVE ENGLISH 2023 " I would definitely recommend St Clare’s because the environment here is very good and the teachers are friendly and kind. The lessons are really fun, it doesn’t feel like school, it’s just like another family! ” Course Structure Build in all four English language skills while exploring the exciting world of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Maths). Combine language learning with innovation and discovery, through coding workshops, hands-on engineering challenges and maths and science workshops at our IB World School.

title: Art & Digital Design
subject: Art & Digital Design
description_short: Explore and develop creative art and digital design techniques in our purpose-built art studio complete with dark room, printing press and a wide range of resources. Be inspired by Oxford’s historical and contemporary architecture, museums and art galleries. Showcase learning through the creation of artwork for an exhibition.
description_full: Explore and develop creative art and digital design techniques in our purpose-built art studio complete with dark room, printing press and a wide range of resources. Be inspired by Oxford’s historical and contemporary architecture, museums and art galleries. Showcase learning through the creation of artwork for an exhibition.

curriculum_sections.title: Course benefits
curriculum_sections.body: Guidance from experienced teachers Learn from professional artists and art teachers who provide personalised support to help you develop your creative style and technical skills. State-of-the-Art Studio Spaces Work in our modern, fully equipped art studio with access to a wide range of resources and tools. Explore a Range of Techniques Experiment with a variety of techniques and media, giving you the freedom to explore, innovate and discover your own unique approach. Inspirational Study Visits Gain inspiration from visits to Oxford’s museums and galleries, drawing on both historical and contemporary art for your own projects. Collaborate with Practising Artists Meet and learn from local professional artists, gaining insight into their creative process and the art world beyond the classroom. Showcase Your Work Create a portfolio of your work and present it at an exhibition at the end of your course. With guidance and feedback from experienced art tutors, you’ll develop a portfolio that showcases your skills and creativity for future university applications or career opportunities. Time to Create, Reflect & Grow Enjoy free time in the studio that will allow you to develop ideas, experiment and reflect, producing meaningful and original artwork. Supportive and Diverse Environment Learn in a safe, welcoming setting alongside classmates from around the world, building cultural awareness and lifelong friendships. ANA BRAZIL, ART & DIGITAL DESIGN 2022 " This course really helped me to be sure of what I want for my future and also put me into this world of art, helping me to see how things work.” Explore and develop creative art and digital design techniques in our purpose-built art studio complete with dark room, printing press and a wide range of resources. Be inspired by Oxford’s historical and contemporary architecture, museums and art galleries. Showcase learning through the creation of artwork for an exhibition. Studio-time: You will be able to dedicate whole mornings or afternoons to work on your projects whilst benefiting from the advice and guidance of our teachers. New techniques: You will have the opportunity to learn and develop a wide range of artistic techniques including: darkroom and digital photographing, editing and displaying 2D drawing, painting, printmaking, illustrating, designing and exhibiting 3D textiles, fashion and casting Exhibition You will work towards the final Friday when you will present your work at an exhibition for your classmates. Study Visits and Guest Speakers Find inspiration in local art galleries and museums, with study visits including the Ashmolean Museum, the Museum of Modern Art Oxford and the North Wall Gallery. Careers Advice Session Our Art & Digital Design course includes a dedicated Careers Advice session, where students meet with our experienced University and Career Counsellors to explore future pathways, university options and career opportunities. This guidance helps students make informed decisions and plan their next steps with confidence. Modern Art Oxford Our Art & Digital Design course also includes a unique relationship with Modern Art Oxford. Students take part in curator-led tours of current exhibitions, hearing directly from the team behind the shows about the decisions that shaped them and having the opportunity to put their own questions to professionals working in the field. On the final exhibition day, a member of the Modern Art Oxford team joins the judging panel to offer students expert, industry-informed feedback on their own work. This connection to the professional art world gives students a genuine insight into creative careers and the transferable skills that underpin them. COURSE STRUCTURE DISCOVER

title: Business & Entrepreneurship
subject: Business & Entrepreneurship
description_short: Explore business studies and entrepreneurship while building your confidence and fluency in Business English. Put your entrepreneurial skills into action by creating and pitching your very own business plan.
description_full: Explore business studies and entrepreneurship while building your confidence and fluency in Business English. Put your entrepreneurial skills into action by creating and pitching your very own business plan.

curriculum_sections.title: Course benefits
curriculum_sections.body: Business Theory and Practice Follow the journey of a business idea, from first concept to final launch. Learn how to develop a product, create a budget, develop a marketing strategy and present your idea - just like an entrepreneur! Build Confidence in Business English Improve your fluency and vocabulary in Business English, while developing the language skills you need for academic and professional success and practise your persuasive presentation skills. Real-World Business Insights Benefit from Guest Speakers and Study Visits to local enterprises in Oxford, gaining first-hand exposure to professional business settings. Creative Business Project Turn knowledge into practice by developing an innovative business idea and pitching your own business plan to a panel. Small Class Sizes & Dedicated Support With a maximum of 12 students per class, you’ll receive close guidance, personal feedback and support from experienced teachers. International Environment Study in a global community, work in an international team and begin building your own international business network. Careers Advice & Future Pathways Take part in a careers advice session, helping you explore your higher education and career options in business and understand the next steps to achieve your goals. Study in an Inspiring Location Oxford’s history, architecture and global reputation for innovation provide a unique and motivating environment for your studies. BEATRIZ BRAZIL, BUSINESS & ENTREPRENEURSHIP 2022 " We discuss really important subjects. We had great lessons about globalisation, leadership, the workplace, the education system and I think it was very constructive for my career. ” Explore business studies and entrepreneurship while building your confidence and fluency in Business English. Put your entrepreneurial skills into action by creating and pitching your very own business plan. Study Visits and Guest Speakers Being based in the academic city of Oxford gives students access to an exciting programme of Guest Speakers and Study Visits. Recent speakers include local serial entrepreneur Ani Haykumi (MBA Oxon, CEO of Vann, a Healthtech company backed by Oxford University Innovation), Dr Tom Crawford (PhD Applied Mathematics, Cambridge), Christian Adofo (Nike Journalist & Brand Creative Writer) and Dr Marcus Nyman (Senior Policy Officer, RSPB; PhD Geography, Cambridge). Study visits have taken students to the Mini BMW Plant and into Oxford to undertake market research, offering rich learning beyond the classroom. Careers Advice Session Our Business & Entrepreneurship course includes a dedicated Careers Advice session, where students meet with our experienced University and Career Counsellors to explore future pathways, university options and career opportunities. This guidance helps students make informed decisions and plan their next steps with confidence. COURSE STRUCTURE DISCOVER
